Rule 1. Every situation must at least match the overall risk reduction posture of each competitor as best we can tell, if all of the following hold: (a) that competitor is classified as "develops_highly_capable"; (b) both that situation is classified as "highly_capable" and that situation is classified as "competitors_evidence".
